evidence.quote:
DM: Um. As the sun sinks towards the horizon in the deserts of eastern Dunmar, you, hiding in a small canyon south of the ruined village of Bas Udda, begin to set your camp. It's been a long day of strange magic and as the evening comes on with it the relative safety of camp you finally have a chance to assess the heaps of magic and treasure that you've dragged from Agata's hut. As Seeker is poking over the magic and figuring out what many of the smaller items do—see the notes I sent you—around the camp, the prisoners you freed are stirring. Huddled in a ball moaning as he sips water from a waterskin, is an older Dunmari man, once a table, in soiled clothes tattered with age. A few moments ago, he was trapped by Agata's magic, but now freed by Seeker's spell he seems disoriented and scared and hasn't spoken a word yet, but is fully human and alive.

Nearby Agata's wooden chair also suspected to be trapped Dunmari rests so far defeating Seeker's attempts to break the enchantment. Only one wooden doll remains: a younger Dunmari woman, so if this indeed is a trapped person that must be her.

Resting by the fire away from the Dunmari is the freed puppet of Agata once a once a wooden scarecrow with human eyes, the halfling Garret Tealeaf, is an elderly man still somewhat disbelieving the power of your magic and the fact that he is free but sitting with a cool drink and anticipating a fresh meal, life seems to be coming back to his eyes a little bit and color to his face. However, he still stays far from the piles of treasure and magic you took from Agata's lair, especially the mirror seeming wary of anything associated with her.

Most prominent among the pile of treasures scattered on the desert canyon floor is a four foot tall heavy mirror—this mirror weighs about 50 pounds—of polished silver now tightly wrapped in a cloak. This mirror, a mirror of soul trapping that can imprison any who see their reflection in a featureless extradimensional cell, caused no end of trouble and still looms over camp, despite the knowledge you have started to gain on how to control that. Many other treasures lay scattered about including a small fortune in coins and silver, a number of valuable trinkets jewelry and art that were presumably largely acquired by Agata as payment for services rendered and a number of magical items some weirder and creepier than others. So, as you sit around the fire contemplating the scene, a few hours before full dark, what would you like to accomplish?
